data.summary_en: MetaExp trains models via verifiable task families (Shared-Tool and Shared-Workflow) with controllable cross-task structure, turning interaction feedback into transferable experience, and fine-tunes Qwen3.5-122B-A10B on 4,956 trajectories; with downstream parameters frozen, it gains +8.5 points on SpreadsheetBench, +14.8 on AutomationBench, and a peak +2.3 on APEX-Agents.
